content: Pɔl bàmufüün
Ungö a ilä ityeen, mfum a angaŋ Ananyas anà andweer anà nkalsà mwɛy ikɔb ande Tɛrtülüs, bàtyà ntɔn mufüün Pɔl akà kuvernɔ̈ɔ̈r.
Apan, ba bàbel Pɔl. Tɛrtülüs kàsɛmà mukun'füün abà: « Mwol Filikisi, mbɔr angye. Ntɔn ngye anà ndaa akün an'kyer ngye ntɔn musyen nsi unsà ubwaŋ banswà, lalan ibà bi uboo a duu aŋàkwo.
Taaŋ lanswà anà ntsü yanswà, bi ibàmukömà ubwaŋ angye.
Wɛɛ mukɔɔn akà adwääl taaŋ mbɔɔn, mɛ in'tɛn ikikye, lalan mɛ amalɔm mukan'wem unsà igyɛɛŋ kyanswà asànaa kayöb bi.
Bi kan'man naa mbuur wà, wà fway, nde wàmuyisà lingyoomà uboo a Ayudà banswà u mɛɛn manswà ntɔn nde wà mfum a Bànazɔrye.
Nde sye alàkwen mubɛy un'kyɛɛl a ndwà a Nzam, undiir awun bun'kör bi. Bi bàkwen mutsul nsaŋ ande asànaa ukalɔɔmà un'kɔɔn abi,
wɛɛ mfum a nsaab waa kàyun'duum a ngwal yanswà kà an'kɔɔ abi.
Abun, ngye, ngye ŋakwo asun'fuul un'lɔɔn, ngye akyer akyey naa ndaa kàmun'füün bi yà ndandaa. »
Ayudà banswà bàkyey naa ndaa yanswà kàtɛn Tɛrtülüs yà abwɛy.
Pɔl kusà a Filikisi

Apan kuvɛrnɔ̈ɔ̈r kun'swɛŋ musà ndaa, Pɔl waa kàfuur abà: « Mɛ in'kyàyöb naa sɛmà mbul mbɔɔn ngye afàswaŋ balàbal akà un'sɛŋ abi: undiirawà, waa mɛ an'sà làkyän akà ngye, mɛ in'sà un'lɔɔn amɛ kusà angye.
Ngye an'kwo ayim ubwaŋàbwaŋ: ilyaaŋ anki ilä kwem aŋiyweel kàbeenà mɛ Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mukàsyäŋà.
Itàkal u ndwà a Nzam, itàkal u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, itàkal uboo a bul, akà mbuur mwɛy kan'mɛn anki musà mbaaŋ anà mbuur itàkal musiinà un'sɛŋ a baar mukyer lingyoomà.
Ba bàkwo anki mukaswaŋ apanà indiir bàkan'füünà ba.

Wɛɛ mɛ, ndaa in'yöb mɛ kusà angye ayi: mɛ in'fàsyääl Mbwo ayà bàmanà ba naa yà loor. Mɛ in'fàsyääl Nzam a andweer abi. Làkwikilà amɛ là unsà ndaa yanswà bàsön uboo a Un'kɔɔn anà uboo a Aŋangɔɔm.
Làkyän amɛ là akà Nzam, ba ŋakwo sye bàkyer afàkyey la, naa baar mpa abà balàbal anà baar a balàbal bàkyer asàwiyà.
Lalan mɛ sye in'fàsà mɛ ngwal taaŋ lanswà mukal anà an'kyän mpa ban'kwo mubɛy kusà a Nzam anà kusà a baar.
Ungö a mbul mbɔɔn, mɛ kàyàfurà u Yɛlusàlɛm ntɔn mubay un'sɛŋ amɛ anà mupà an'kab.
Apan ba bàyan'man u ndwà a Nzam ungö a mpɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ amɛ: akà nköŋ mwɛy itàkal làso làmwɛy làkäl anki.
Wɛɛ Ayudà amwɛy bà Azi bàkäl paa, ba baar bàlàkwo muyàmɛnà kusà a ngye mukan'füün ilàkal naa ba bàkäl anà undiir atɛn a mɛ.
Itàkal ba abà, ba ŋakwo bàtɛn ndaa a ube bàmɛn ba mpal kasi mɛ un'lɔɔn u Làbay a Nsaŋ a Kölàköl.
Taaŋ lumwɛy ndaa mwɛy mpɛl kàsi mɛ umbäär kusà a ba naa: "Yà ntɔn ngwiiyà a akü lalan bàman'füün ba ŋàbawà kusà a bɛ!" »
Filikisi kàkyer ayöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ ndaa a Mbwo, waa kàsin mutsul ungö anà mutɛn naa: « Mɛ ndaa abɛ in'yàtsul mpal uyàtyà mfum a nsaab. »
Apan nde kàswɛŋ kaptɛn mwɛy mukaar Pɔl u bɔlokà anà mukun'pà mbwo naa atɔŋ ban'kwo mukun'bay.
Pɔl kusà a Filikisi anà Dulàsiye
Ungö a ndam a ilä, Filikisi kàkäl anà un'kyay ande Dulàsiye, un'kaar un'yudà, nde kàtöm baar mukàbel Pɔl. Nde kàkwen mukun'wem ntɔn ndaa a làkwikilà unsà Klistɔ Yɛsu.

Wɛɛ mpal kàsɛmà Pɔl mutɛn ndaa mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a balàbal anà nkääŋ a mpem anà nsaŋ isàyà kusà, Filikisi kàwem bɔɔmà, waa kàtɛn naa: « Apanà ngye an'kwo afurà. Taaŋ làsàkal mɛ in'kyer afasàbel. »
Nde kàsii naa Pɔl ayun'pà ngim, undiir awun kàfatɔmà nde baar mbalà mbɔɔn mukun'bel u bɔlokà ntɔn muyäm anà nde.
Ungö a mbul yweel, Filikisi bun'kiir akà Pɔrsyus Fɛstüs. Wɛɛ, ntɔn muswaŋ ubwaŋ ande akà Ayudà, nde kàsàwɛy Pɔl u bɔlokà.
